data.narrative:
Delian Alliance Industries is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $14M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public and 8 private—spanning the same sector and adjacent funding stages, including reference points such as UFORCE, Stark Defence, Singularity, and NODA AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $14M total raised as a base proxy and applies a typical 2.5x multiplier for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying a $35M valuation. Peer-median analysis evaluates the four sampled comparables—which range from $125M (NODA AI, Series A) to $4.0B (Stark Defence, Series A)—yielding a median valuation of $700M. The disparity reflects heterogeneity in company maturity, technology differentiation, and customer traction within the Defense & Security sector.

The two-method triangulation yields a valuation range of $30M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $368M. This wide band reflects genuine uncertainty inherent in valuing an early-stage company against peers at later funding stages and with significantly different scales. Key sensitivities include the trajectory of Delian's technical validation, customer acquisition in defense markets, and whether the company's positioning more closely mirrors the Seed-stage profile of UFORCE or the Series A profiles of the comparables. Further diligence on revenue traction and IP defensibility would narrow this range.
